data.name: Tabbie
data.long_meaning: The name Tabbie is derived from the English word 'tabby', which originally referred to a type of striped cat. Over time, the name came to be used as a diminutive for Tabitha, a biblical name derived from the Greek word 'tabita', meaning 'gazer' or 'observer'. Thus, Tabbie can be seen as a dainty or small version of the observant Tabitha.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying introspection and attentiveness to one's surroundings.
